lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Moshe Velasquez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Moshe is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Ashford watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Moshe Velasquez is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Moshe kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Moshe's gone." Dieter looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Moshe." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Chester blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
